items.message:
Strong winds and large waves today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 13:00 to 19:00 on 20/10/2026. 
Locations most effected will be coastal roads and footpaths on The North Sea coast from Bridlington to Barmston. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . Conditions are forecast to improve tomorrow. 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded. Sea conditions are likely to remain rough for the remainder of the week. 
This message will be updated by 9:00PM on Tuesday 20 October or as the situation changes.

items.description: River Cole, Dorcan Brook and South Marston Brook
items.message:
Forecast rising river levels this morning may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from the morning of Tuesday 20 October .
Flooding of low lying land and roads is expected, especially in the Covingham Drive area. Further rainfall is forecast throughout this morning and could be heavy at times before becoming lighter later on this afternoon. We expect river levels to rise until this afternoon and will start to drop again into this evening.
We are monitoring rainfall and river levels .
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses. Refer to River Levels online for more information.
This message will be updated by 7:00PM on Tuesday 20 October or as the situation changes.
